info.title: DabApp Marketplace API
info.description:
Storefront API of the parts & accessories marketplace, for the mobile app and the web.

## Before you call anything

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Base path | `/api/marketplace/...` (same host as the rest of the DabApp API) |
| Header on **every** call | `Accept: application/json` |
| Logged-in calls | `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (the same token as the rest of the app). In this page click **Authorize** once and paste the token. |
| Uploads (logo, cover...) | `multipart/form-data`. A file field is sent as a file part, not as base64. |
| Files | Every `*_url` is an absolute URL, or `null` when there is no file. |
| Languages | Names come as `name` and `name_ar`. The app picks the one that matches the user's language. |

## Who can call what

| Level | Token | A guest gets |
|---|---|---|
| **Public** | not needed | the data |
| **User** | required | `401` with `requires_auth: true` |

A guest hitting a *User* endpoint gets exactly this. Open your login screen, then repeat the call:

```json
{ "success": false, "error": "Unauthenticated", "message": "You must be authenticated to access this resource.", "requires_auth": true, "action": "login" }
```

## Response shapes

| Case | Status | Body |
|---|---|---|
| Read | 200 | `{ "data": ... }` |
| Write | 200 / 201 | `{ "message": "...", "data": ... }` |
| List | 200 | `{ "data": [...], "meta": { "current_page", "per_page", "last_page", "total" } }`. Ask with `?page=1&per_page=15` (max 50). |
| Not found | 404 | `{ "message": "..." }` |
| Refused | 403 / 409 | `{ "message": "...", "code": "SOME_CODE" }`. **Use `code` in your logic, show `message` to the user.** |
| Invalid input | 422 | `{ "errors": { "field": ["message"] } }`. Show each message under its field. |

## Flows worth knowing

- **Browse**: categories, brands, shops. No login.
- **Become a seller**: `POST /vendor/apply`, then poll `GET /vendor/me` and use its `status` to pick the screen: `pending`, `rejected` (show `status_reason`, let the user resubmit), `suspended`, `active`.

get.description: Active brands with their number of visible products. With category_id (sub-categories included) only brands that have products there are returned. Access: Public.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only brands with products in this category or its descendants

200.description: Brands, featured first then A-Z. products_count counts visible products (with category_id: only those inside that category).

empty.summary: Nothing matches (search=zzz): an empty list, never a 404

get.description: Without parent_id: top-level categories. With parent_id: its direct children. With tree=1 every level is nested under 'children'. Only active categories. Access: Public.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Return the children of this category instead of the top level

200.description: Categories, ordered as the admin arranged them.

tree.summary: tree=1: every level nested under children (leaves have an empty children list)

404.description: parent_id does not exist or is inactive

get.description: Category with its breadcrumb (root to parent) and direct children. Access: Public.

Everything the home screen needs in one call, in the order the screen shows them: Shops, Accessories (categories), Bike Type, Brand. bike_types and bike_brands come from the app's existing vehicle tables (the same ones the moto listings use), not from the marketplace catalog: 'Bike Brand' means Honda / KTM / Yamaha (who made the bike), never a marketplace parts brand like Michelin. Both are filtered down to only the ones that have at least one compatible product in the marketplace — a brand or type with nothing to sell stays out, so this list is never the full vehicle catalog (500+ brands). Access: Public.

shops.description: Featured shops first, then best rated. View All -> GET /marketplace/vendors.

categories.description: Top-level marketplace categories (the 'Accessories' row on the screen is one example; every root category — Parts, Oils & Care, Accessories, Riding gear — comes back here). View All / tapping one -> GET /marketplace/categories or /marketplace/categories/{id}.

post.description: Resizes to fit inside 1200x800, no watermark (these are catalog/branding assets, not the peer-to-peer listing photos the watermark protects). Returns one absolute URL per file, in the same order. Nothing is attached to any resource yet: pass the URL(s) as a plain string field on the next call (see each resource's endpoint). type=category and type=brand are admin-only (403 ADMIN_ONLY for a regular user). Access: User.

type.description: Picks the storage folder. vendor: shop logo/cover. product: product photos. category/brand: admin only.

images.description: 1 to 10 files, jpg/png/webp, max 8 MB each

403.description: type=category or type=brand from a non-admin token.

example.message: Only admins can upload category images

get.description: Active products of active vendors only. category_id also matches its sub-categories (Tyres also returns Front tyres / Rear tyres). moto_brand_id / moto_model_id / moto_year_id match a product's explicit bike-compatibility rows plus universal parts. attributes[Label][]=Value filters on the spec table (e.g. attributes[Grip Style][]=Open Ended) - see GET /marketplace/products/filters for which labels/values exist in a given view. Access: Public.

parameters.name: brand_id
parameters.description: Parts brand (Michelin) - not the bike's manufacturer

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Map of label to one or more values, e.g. attributes[Finish][]=Matte

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Default newest. relevance=default, most_recent=newest, lowest_price=price_low, highest_price=price_high (app naming -> API naming)

200.description: Products, newest first by default. Load the next page with page+1 until current_page = last_page.

get.summary: Available filters for a catalog view (facets)
get.description: Call it with the same scoping params as the list (category_id, search, vendor_id, brand_id, moto_brand_id/model_id/year_id) to get the options worth showing in the Filters sheet for that exact view, each with how many products it would leave. price reflects the real price (the variant range for products that have variants, not the fallback products.price column). Access: Public.

moto_brands.description: The bike's manufacturer (Honda, BMW, KTM) - the Filters sheet's 'Brand' chip. Use with moto_brand_id, not brand_id.

years.description: Bike compatibility years ('Shop By'). Use with moto_year_id.

attributes.description: Map of attribute label to a list of its values with how many products have that value, e.g. Grip Style: Open Ended (12), Close Ended (3)

ratings.description: min-rating buckets with at least one match

get.description: Full gallery, specs (attributes), variants (color/size/...), bike compatibility and the selling shop. Access: Public.

stock_quantity.description: Ignore when has_variants is true - use each variant's own stock

data.name: BILT Sprint Gloves
data.description: Aggressive, short cuff glove for warm months.

get.description: Approved reviews only, newest first by default. summary.breakdown is the full count per star (1-5) across every approved review, independent of pagination and sort - build the 'Excellent/Very Good/Good/Fair/Poor' bars from it (5=Excellent ... 1=Poor). Access: Public.

data.title: Great Product!!
data.comment: Better than expected! Works fine and everything is working as great as it should be

post.description: One review per user per product (409 ALREADY_REVIEWED on a second attempt - edit isn't supported yet, delete isn't exposed). Updates the product's rating_avg / reviews_count right away. Photos are URLs from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=product), sent as plain strings in images[]. is_anonymous hides your name from the public list (the API still knows who wrote it). Access: User.

comment.example: Great quality, I liked how fast it was shipped!

tags.description: Freeform, e.g. the app's fixed chip list: Build Quality, Delivery Time, Versatility, Availability, Value For Money, Packaging

post.description:
Creates the user's shop with status pending, waiting for admin approval. One shop per user: 409 ALREADY_APPLIED (pending), ALREADY_VENDOR (active) or VENDOR_SUSPENDED. A rejected application can be sent again: it reopens the same shop as pending. Status, slug and commission cannot be set by the user. Access: User.
     *
     * For a logo or a cover, call POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=vendor) first and send the URL(s) it returns as logo_path / cover_image_path. The city must belong to the country (422 on `city_id` otherwise). Load the pickers from `GET /api/countries-list` and `GET /api/cities?country_id=`.

201.description: Application created. Show the 'under review' screen.

200.description: A rejected application was sent again: same shop (same id), back to pending, reason cleared.

message.example: Application sent again, waiting for approval

example.message: Application sent again, waiting for approval

409.description: The user already has a shop. Use `code`, not the message, to choose the screen.

value.message: Your application is already waiting for approval
You already have a vendor account

get.description: The shop owned by the logged-in user, whatever its status, so the app can show 'under review', 'rejected (with the reason)', 'suspended' or the seller space. 404 NO_VENDOR when the user never applied. Access: User.

200.description: My shop. Pick the screen from `status`: pending = under review, rejected = show `status_reason` and a Resubmit button, suspended = show `status_reason`, active = seller space (`can_sell` is true).

rejected.summary: Rejected: show the reason and a Resubmit button

404.description: The user never applied: show the 'Become a seller' screen.

example.message: You do not have a vendor account

put.description: Send only the fields to change. Allowed while pending or active (suspended: 403 VENDOR_SUSPENDED, rejected: use apply to send it again). Send logo_path / cover_image_path: null to remove that image, or omit it to leave it untouched. slug, status and commission are not editable here. Access: User.

logo_path.description: URL from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image, or null to remove it

cover_image_path.description: URL from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image, or null to remove it

200.description: Updated. The response is the whole shop, ready to replace what the app holds.

403.description: The shop is suspended: show the reason, nothing can be edited.

example.message: You do not have a vendor account

409.description: The application was rejected: it cannot be edited, send it again with POST /vendor/apply.

example.message: Your application was rejected, apply again to reopen it

get.description: Active vendors only. products_count = active products of the shop. Access: Public.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Default rating (the All Shops 'Top Rated' tab)

200.description: Shops, best rated first by default. Load the next page with page+1 until current_page = last_page.

get.description: Shop header: branding, rating, contact location, categories the shop sells in, and its enabled shipping methods (flat rate). Bank data, commission and carrier keys are never exposed. Access: Public.

data.description: Tyres, brakes and engine parts for sport and touring bikes.

404.description: Unknown shop, or a shop that is not approved (pending, rejected, suspended). Both look the same to the app.

get.description: Products I favorited, newest first. A product that was deleted or went inactive is silently dropped from the list. Access: User.

post.summary: Add a product to my wishlist
post.description: Idempotent: adding a product that is already there just returns it, no duplicate. Access: User.

404.description: Product not found, or not visible

delete.summary: Remove a product from my wishlist
delete.description: Idempotent: removing a product that is not in the wishlist still returns 200. Access: User.

products_count.description: Visible products in this category and all its sub-categories

is_featured.description: Curated by an admin: the Featured badge on All Shops and eligible for the Marketplace home Shops row

MarketplaceMyVendor.description: The owner's view of their own shop (any status).

status_reason.description: Why it was rejected or suspended

can_sell.description: true only when status is active

message.example: Your application is already waiting for approval

price.description: The cheapest variant's price when has_variants is true, otherwise the product's own price

price_max.description: Set only when has_variants is true and variant prices differ - show as a 'from-to' range

has_variants.description: true = sold by variant (color/size/...), open the detail for the variants array

brand.description: Parts brand (Michelin), not the bike's manufacturer

image_url.description: Falls back to the product's own cover image when null

verified_purchase.description: Always false for now - there is no Orders/Cart yet to verify a purchase against

author.description: null when the reviewer chose is_anonymous

Unauthenticated.description: Guest, or the token expired. Open the login screen, then repeat the call.

example.message: You must be authenticated to access this resource.

ValidationFailed.description: Invalid input. Show each message under its field.

city_id: The selected city id is invalid.

tags.name: Marketplace - Brands
tags.description: Product brands (All Brands screen). Public, no token needed.

tags.name: Marketplace - Categories
tags.description: Category tree of the marketplace (unlimited depth). Public, no token needed.

tags.name: Marketplace - Home
tags.description: One call for the Marketplace home screen. Public, no token needed.

tags.name: Marketplace - Images
tags.description: Upload images before you use them, the same way listings do it: a standalone endpoint that returns URL strings, decoupled from creating or editing the resource. Send those strings as logo_path / cover_image_path / image_path on the vendor, category, brand or product endpoints — those endpoints take plain JSON, never files.

tags.name: Marketplace - Products
tags.description: Catalog: list with search/filters, filter facets, product detail. Public, no token needed. Only active products of active vendors are ever visible.

tags.name: Marketplace - Reviews
tags.description: Product reviews: rating, a title/comment, 'what did you like' tags, photos. List is public; writing one needs a token. verified_purchase is always false for now - Orders/Cart (Step 5) aren't built yet, so there is nothing to verify a purchase against.

tags.name: Marketplace - Vendor account
tags.description: A logged-in user applies to become a vendor and manages their own shop profile. Access: User (Bearer JWT). A guest gets the structured 401 (requires_auth=true). Being a vendor = owning a shop whose status is active; an admin approves applications from the Admin Panel. logo_path / cover_image_path are URLs from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=vendor), not files: upload first, then send the strings here.

tags.name: Marketplace - Vendors
tags.description: Shops (All Shops screen and shop page). Public, no token needed. Only approved (active) vendors are ever visible.
